rows: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted

scale_cues: Large stainless steel mixing bowl, roughly 30 cm across the rim. The food sits in a small cluster at the center of the base. Each olive is about 3 cm long, and the chicken cubes are about 2 cm.
assumptions: The white cubes are cooked chicken breast. They could also be another lean poultry or a firm tofu-like item.
The dark ovals are kalamata olives. I counted about 10 and assumed they have pits, at about 4-5 g each.
No visible sauce. Any cooking oil is minimal, so I did not list it as a separate item.
The bowl is empty apart from the food, and the shine on the chicken may mean a small amount of oil.
